notes.title: Chinese (Simplified) title added
notes.content:
*This text is a machine translation.

Added title in Chinese (simplified).
The title of “無垢を裂く” in Chinese (simplified) is “予无垢以裂痕”.

There is no language support on the store page at the moment, but there is a Chinese (Simplified) patch for this game “Rip the Innocence” by a volunteer.
This can be downloaded from the link on the official website.

Please consider it when playing!
